title: Brush Your Teeth with Sunny! Swish Swish! 🪥
description: Sunny wakes up and shows little ones how to brush their teeth, up and down and round and round. A happy morning routine to copy along.

beats.line: Yawn! Good morning, friends! Guess what time it is?
It's brush-your-teeth time! Grab your toothbrush!
Brush up and down. Up and down. Swish, swish!
Now round and round, like a little train. Choo choo!
Oops! I brushed my nose! Silly Sunny!
Now show me your big, shiny smile!
Wow! You sparkle just like me!
